Title: Custom report tooltips and Q&A explorer available for Power BI Embedded

Body.Content:
Power BI Embedded offers additional support for customization:

  • Report tooltips: You can use customized tooltips on reports to make tooltips more appealing, rich, and informative. Learn how to create and use the new tooltips. 
  • Q&A explorer: The natural-language querying feature is now available for users who consume and interact with reports. This feature will work in your applications by embedding reports that added this feature. In Power BI Embedded, you can also embed Q&A in your application separately from reports or dashboards.
